site.name: Home Run Mine
site.location: Lakewood / Boulder County Tungsten Mining District
overview: The Home Run Mine is a documented historic tungsten mine in Boulder County's tungsten district, north of Sugarloaf Road near Lakewood.
Colorado Geological Survey records identify the property in the northeast quarter of Section 6, Township 1 South, Range 72 West and describe shallow shafts and surface cuts.

timeline.text: Colorado Geological Survey's first report documented Home Run ore from the Boulder County tungsten field.
Colorado Geological Survey later reported about 100 units of tungsten production from the Home Run property during World War I.

moreHistory: Colorado Geological Survey MI-04 records the Home Run Mine north of Sugarloaf Road near Lakewood and identifies Crucible Steel Company of America as the historic owner.
The same source describes shallow shafts and surface cuts and records horn and crystalline tungsten ore.

A USGS/MRDS-derived mapped mine point at approximately 39.99306, -105.49167 is used as a defensible mine-level identification anchor; Remnant does not represent that point as a field-surveyed surviving shaft collar.

sources.title: MI-04 Tungsten Mines of Colorado
sources.note: Home Run entry documents location, ownership, World War I production, workings, and ore occurrence.
